description: This file defines the `ProjectViewDetail` class, which extends `ViewDetail`, and overrides its `display` method to load and display details of a 'Project' entity in the SuiteCRM system. It sets template variables related to user permissions and loads the relevant 'Project' bean for rendering.

classes.name: ProjectViewDetail
classes.description: A class extending `ViewDetail` that customizes the display behavior for the Project module's detail view.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Loads the Project bean for the current record and assigns template variables based on user permissions before rendering the detail view.
